title: AI Governance: Ensuring Ethics and Inclusion
summary: Effective AI governance requires a multifaceted approach that prioritizes ethics, inclusivity, and accountability. UNESCO's recommendation on the ethics of artificial intelligence provides a framework for nations to place human rights at the forefront. However, challenges persist in ensuring transparency, trust, and responsible use of AI.
